detailed_descriptions.en: PIX Football Manager is an online asynchronous PvP, no single-player retro football management sim built around one idea: the best way to find a great player is to watch them play. You won’t know every player’s true ability before signing them. Every signing is a gamble. Some will disappoint. Others will become club legends. Create your club and lead it through season after season. Scout players from over 350 clubs across 25 countries, build your tactics, manage contracts and finances, improve your facilities, and watch your decisions play out in fully simulated matches. Watch Matches, Scout Players! Watch fully simulated pixel-art football unfold from more than 350 clubs across 25 countries, trust what you see and uncover talent others overlook. Scout players yourself, or hire agents to search and negotiate on your behalf. Win Players Over --> Win the Auction Some targets care about your club’s identity, popularity or facilities; others care most about money. Build a club they want to join, then outbid your rivals. Create the Ultimate Dream Team! React with tactical changes and substitutions as the match develops. Balance chemistry, individual strengths, fitness and assemble the right team. Balance the Books Choose between signings, contract renewals, facilities and stadium upgrades, then set ticket, food and shirt prices to grow matchday income. Plan for the Future Invest in better facilities to improve training and reduce injury risk, while developing your Youth Academy to prepare the next generation of players. Compete Season After Season! Face clubs built by other managers without waiting for them to be online at the same time. Fight through week-long leagues and scheduled knockout cups, chasing promotion, avoiding relegation and collecting trophies. Arrange friendlies against friends’ squads and settle who has built the better side. Find legendary players! Find legendary players at different points of their career!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
PIX Football Manager is an online asynchronous PvP, no single-player retro football management sim built around one idea: the best way to find a great player is to watch them play. You won’t know every player’s true ability before signing them. Every signing is a gamble. Some will disappoint. Others will become club legends.

Create your club and lead it through season after season. Scout players from over 350 clubs across 25 countries, build your tactics, manage contracts and finances, improve your facilities, and watch your decisions play out in fully simulated matches.

Watch Matches, Scout Players!

  • Watch fully simulated pixel-art football unfold from more than 350 clubs across 25 countries, trust what you see and uncover talent others overlook.

  • Scout players yourself, or hire agents to search and negotiate on your behalf.

  • Win Players Over --> Win the Auction  

    • Some targets care about your club’s identity, popularity or facilities; others care most about money. Build a club they want to join, then outbid your rivals.

Create the Ultimate Dream Team!

  • React with tactical changes and substitutions as the match develops.

  • Balance chemistry, individual strengths, fitness and assemble the right team.

Balance the Books

  • Choose between signings, contract renewals, facilities and stadium upgrades, then set ticket, food and shirt prices to grow matchday income.

Plan for the Future

  • Invest in better facilities to improve training and reduce injury risk, while developing your Youth Academy to prepare the next generation of players.

Compete Season After Season!

  • Face clubs built by other managers without waiting for them to be online at the same time. Fight through week-long leagues and scheduled knockout cups, chasing promotion, avoiding relegation and collecting trophies.

  • Arrange friendlies against friends’ squads and settle who has built the better side.

Find legendary players!

  • Find legendary players at different points of their career!
